`unicode-segmentation` is vendored from unicode-rs/unicode-segmentation commit
4444c95cf31f3bae48aa98b9f96b66332a8836fd (Unicode 18.0 tables).
It retains the upstream dual MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses and COPYRIGHT.
Generation source: scripts/unicode.py in that directory. Its generated tables
are committed in src/tables.rs. No project changes are made to upstream code.
`unicode-width` 0.2.3 also reports Unicode 18.0.0; Cargo.lock pins its checksum.
